definitions.explanation: Lacking in logic, reason, or fairness. Used to describe systems, rules, arguments, or situations that do not make sense or are not justified.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不合理|ふごうり}だ。
{不合理|ふごうり}な⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧べきだ。

⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧きた{不合理|ふごうり}な⟦{慣習|かんしゅう}→慣習：05523_kanshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}ている→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The time has come to reexamine unreasonable customs that have continued for many years.

notes:
USAGE:
{不合理|ふごうり} is the opposite of ⟦{合理的|ごうりてき}→合理的：06199_gouriteki⟧ (rational, reasonable). It is used in formal and intellectual discussions to critique systems, rules, or arguments.

Note that {不合理|ふごうり} focuses on logical inconsistency, while ⟦{不条理|ふじょうり}→不条理：16409_fujouri⟧ (absurd, unreasonable) has a more philosophical or existential connotation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不合理|ふごうり}な⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: irrational system
- {不合理|ふごうり}な⟦{差別|さべつ}→差別：01633_sabetsu⟧: unreasonable discrimination
- {不合理|ふごうり}な⟦{慣習|かんしゅう}→慣習：05523_kanshuu⟧: unreasonable custom
- {不合理|ふごうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}す→正す：10132_tadasu⟧: to correct what is unreasonable
